LESSON: HADITH ON DRESSING

Grade: Grade 6
Subject: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: HADITHI
Topic 2.2: Hadith on dressing
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 3

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Hadith on dressing, part of HADITHI in Grade 6 ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION.

Key inquiry question: Why should the male and female dress differently? 2. What is the purpose of dressing?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

A. Suggested learning experiences (from KICD)

1. read the Hadith on dressing: “The Messenger of Allah (S.A.W.) cursed the man who wears women’s clothing and the woman who wears men’s clothing.” (Abu-Daud),

2. classify clothes and accessories according to gender (trousers, skirts, blouses, shirts, shorts, necklaces, earrings, bangles, hair dressing) using digital devices/pocket boards/charts,

3. discuss the male and female dress code as per the Sunnah of the Prophet (S.A.W.) and make class presentation,

4. draw and colour different clothes and accessories and display, 1.

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

1. read the Hadith on dressing: “The Messenger of Allah (S.A.W.) cursed the man who wears women’s clothing and the woman who wears men’s clothing.” (Abu-Daud),
2. classify clothes and accessories according to gender (trousers, skirts, blouses, shirts, shorts, necklaces, earrings, bangles, hair dressing) using digital devices/pocket boards/charts,
3. discuss the male and female dress code as per the Sunnah of the Prophet (S.A.W.) and make class presentation,
4. draw and colour different clothes and accessories and display, 1.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Hadith on dressing together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
• Creativity and Imagination: making connections as learners model, draw and colour different clothes and accessories.

• Communication and Collaboration: listening, speaking, writing and teamwork skills attained as learners discuss the male

and female dress code as per the Sunnah of the Prophet (S.A.W.) and make class presentation.

• Digital Literacy: Interacting with digital technology skill attained as learners classify clothes and accessories according to

gender (trousers, skirts, blouses, shirts, shorts, necklaces, earrings, bangles, hair dressing etc) using digital devices.

Values:
• Respect: Islamic etiquette enhanced as the learners respect each other’s views during group discussion.

• Responsibility: model appropriate dress for different gender.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
(PCIs):

Life skills: Human Sexuality aspects realised as learners dress as per the Islamic teachings for different genders.

Link to other Learning Areas:

Agriculture: covers content on dressing for different occasions and decency.
